<!-- example-1: body_md -->
Let $g(x)$ be the function $g(x)=\frac{1}{\sqrt{x(1-x)}}$, $0 < x < 1$, then evaluate the integral $\int_0^1 g(x)dx$.
<!-- end example-1 -->
<!-- example-2: body_md -->
The most famous change of variables of the plane is the Polar transformation which changes rectangular system of coordinates in polar coordinates.
 \begin{equation}\label{eq:polar}
 T(\theta,r)=(x(\theta,r)\,,\,y(\theta,r))=(r\cos(\theta)\,,\,r\sin(\theta)).
 \end{equation}
<!-- end example-2 -->
